title: Quantity Words: Some, Any, A Lot Of
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora puedes expresar cantidades de manera natural en inglés usando some, any, a lot of y otras expresiones de cantidad.

parts.visual: 'Some' se usa en afirmaciones y ofertas: We have some coffee (Tenemos café). Would you like some water? 'Any' en preguntas y negaciones: Do you have any questions? We don't have any budget.
parts.audio: Some is used in positive sentences and offers: We have some coffee. Would you like some water? Any is used in questions and negatives: Do you have any questions? We don't have any budget.

parts.visual: 'A lot of' / 'Lots of' = mucho/muchos (contable e incontable): We have a lot of work. There are a lot of clients. 'A few' = unos pocos (contable). 'A little' = un poco (incontable).
parts.audio: A lot of or Lots of means much or many, for both countable and uncountable: We have a lot of work. There are a lot of clients. A few means a small number for countable. A little means a small amount for uncountable.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra de cantidad correcta.

questions.question: We have ____ coffee in the break room. (Afirmación).
There is ____ work to do this week. (Mucho trabajo).
I have ____ minutes before the meeting. (Unos pocos minutos).
I need ____ time to finish this. (Un poco de tiempo).
There are ____ emails in my inbox. (Muchos).
We have ____ problems to solve. (Unos pocos problemas).
I need ____ more information. (Un poco más de información).
There ____ not any tickets left. (No quedan entradas).
I have ____ ideas to share. (Algunas ideas - afirmación).
There are ____ candidates for the position. (No hay ninguno).
We have ____ experience with this. (Poca experiencia).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra de cantidad correcta.

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We have some coffee in the break room.
options: We have some coffee in the break room.
We have any coffee in the break room.
They have some coffee in the break room.
We have some tea in the break room.
questions.correct_answer: We have some coffee in the break room.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We don't have any budget left.
options: We don't have any budget left.
They don't have any budget left.
We don't have much budget left.
questions.correct_answer: We don't have any budget left.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: There is a lot of work this week.
options: There is a lot of work this week.
There was a lot of work this week.
There is lots of work this week.
There is a lot of work next week.
questions.correct_answer: There is a lot of work this week.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I have a few minutes before the meeting.
options: I have a few minutes before the meeting.
I have a little time before the meeting.
She has a few minutes before the meeting.
I had a few minutes before the meeting.
questions.correct_answer: I have a few minutes before the meeting.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I need a little more time.
options: I need a little more time.
I need a few more minutes.
She needs a little more time.
I want a little more time.
questions.correct_answer: I need a little more time.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: There are lots of emails in my inbox.
options: There are lots of emails in my inbox.
There is lots of email in my inbox.
There are a lot of emails in my inbox.
There were lots of emails in my inbox.
questions.correct_answer: There are lots of emails in my inbox.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: There are no candidates for the position.
options: There are no candidates for the position.
There are not any candidates for the position.
There is no candidate for the position.
There were no candidates for the position.
questions.correct_answer: There are no candidates for the position.
